themes: Indonesia's downstream processing mandate (smelting/refining) continues to structurally re-rate nickel and tin producers as export bans lock in domestic value-add and global supply tightens.

Energy transition policy and gas infrastructure buildout (AGII) create durable upside for midstream gas players as domestic industrial demand outpaces LNG export commitments.

Watch AGII for gas monetization upside. Overall sector momentum is positive but US weakness caps beta; add on dips, avoid chasing +20% movers.
